module.name: Busbar Permissions Audit
module.blurb: Cedar-based security analysis of Salesforce metadata — permissions, sharing, FLS, flows.
module.longDescription: Surfaces over-privileged permission sets, permissive sharing, FLS mismatches, without-sharing flows, and escalation paths — each with a remediation citation — as JSON findings and SARIF.

inputs.name: metadata-path
inputs.label: Metadata path
inputs.description: Directory or MDAPI zip of Salesforce metadata to audit.

inputs.name: severity-threshold
inputs.label: Minimum severity
inputs.description: Lowest severity to include in the report.

inputs.name: fail-on-severity
inputs.label: Fail on severity
inputs.description: Exit non-zero if any finding meets or exceeds this severity.
